note: 📥️ The paged command-ingress contract, shared by the TypeScript host writer (🎭️actor/📮️shard-client's createShardCommandIngressPages) and the Rust guest reader (📡️spr/🧵️channel's CommandPageSet/PagedCommand/PagedCommandReader). A command crosses as a stream of pageBytes-sized pages, one page per actor turn, reassembled in arrival order with exact accounting. No row is a chosen ceiling: pageBytes is the page extent, commandMaximumBytes is the guest linear-memory budget's own hostAnswerCeilingBytes (⏱️trace/🧮️memory/🧬️schema/🔣️.json), and maximumPages is one over the other.
